participant_id.description: Harmonised participant identifier. In the modality metadata, the leading 'sub-' prefix is removed.

session.description: Participant session identifier. In the modality metadata, the leading 'ses-' prefix is removed; 'NA' is used when no session folder is present.

anat.description: Availability flag for anatomical MRI data; 1 when the anat folder exists and contains at least one file, otherwise 0.

fmri.description: Availability flag for functional MRI data; 1 when the func folder exists and contains at least one file, otherwise 0.

dwi.description: Availability flag for diffusion-weighted MRI data; 1 when the dwi folder exists and contains at least one file, otherwise 0.

directory.description: Absolute path to the participant/session directory used when building the harmonised modality metadata.

age.description: Age of the participant as provided in the harmonised participant metadata.

group.description: Harmonised subject diagnostic group. Includes overlapping syndromes. For example, dysthymia in MDD and child/adolescent early diagnoses of depression and anxiety are also labelled under MDD and GAD. Check the original diagnosis if more specificity is required.

diagnostic_instrument.description: Diagnostic instrument or instruments used to diagnose the case group.

scanner.description: MRI scanner/site ID; if not present, all participants were scanned on the same scanner.
